name: 15419 · California, PA
findings: ZIP 15419 (California) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15419 (California) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15419 (California) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
